_source.title: Reduce slow search responses
_source.content: Diagnose query latency with the profile API. Narrow expensive filters and avoid retrieving large unnecessary fields.

_source.title: Improve response time for dashboards
_source.content: Investigate slow searches by examining shard execution times, request caches and the number of concurrent queries.

_source.title: Expensive wildcard requests
_source.content: Leading wildcards scan many terms. Use a suitable field mapping and more selective queries to make searches faster.

_source.title: Limit the result payload
_source.content: Return only the title and summary instead of the entire document. Smaller search responses reduce network transfer and client processing.

_source.title: Measure shard request latency
_source.content: Search profiling identifies expensive query clauses and aggregations. Compare measurements before and after an optimization.

_source.title: Tune vector retrieval candidates
_source.content: Nearest neighbor retrieval balances recall and latency. Increase candidates carefully and measure search quality alongside response time.

_source.title: Find answers by meaning
_source.content: A sentence encoder maps related questions to nearby vectors even when their words differ. Retrieve useful passages by cosine similarity.

_source.title: Semantic search with supplied vectors
_source.content: Semantic search uses an embedding model to represent text meaning. Index the document embeddings and query with a vector produced by the same model.

_source.title: Hybrid semantic search ranking
_source.content: Hybrid search combines lexical relevance and semantic search. Reciprocal rank fusion joins ranked lists without comparing raw BM25 and vector scores.

_source.title: Keyword relevance for exact names
_source.content: BM25 matches the terms in a question to document text. Exact product names and identifiers may be easier to retrieve with lexical search.

_source.title: Vector metadata restrictions
_source.content: Apply tenant and publication restrictions while nearest neighbor retrieval finds candidates. A filter applied after retrieval can return too few hits.

_source.title: Semantic search evaluation checklist
_source.content: Evaluate semantic search with representative questions. Measure useful results, language coverage and ranking quality before changing the model.

_source.title: Search cache and repeated requests
_source.content: Repeated identical search requests can benefit from caches. Benchmark realistic workloads because a cache hit does not represent every user query.

_source.title: Choose a useful retrieval window
_source.content: A larger candidate window gives hybrid retrieval more documents to fuse. Keep the final page small and evaluate the tradeoff against latency.

_source.title: Unpublished latency diagnosis
_source.content: Find help diagnosing slow searches and improving query response times. This draft contains internal performance experiments and must stay out of published results.

_source.title: Requêtes lentes et temps de réponse
_source.content: Analyser les recherches lentes, réduire les filtres coûteux et mesurer le temps de réponse des requêtes.

_source.title: Trace a slow checkout
_source.content: Follow distributed traces across checkout services. Identify database waits and network calls that increase customer transaction latency.

_source.title: Monitor application error rates
_source.content: Group failures by service and environment. Alert on a sustained increase in errors rather than an isolated request.

_source.title: Read structured application logs
_source.content: Parse timestamp, service name and severity from incoming logs. Search the resulting fields when diagnosing application incidents.

_source.title: Choose infrastructure metrics
_source.content: CPU, memory pressure and disk utilization describe host health. Correlate these measurements with service response time.

_source.title: Track latency percentiles
_source.content: Percentiles show how quickly typical and unusually slow requests finish. An average can hide the long tail experienced by some customers.

_source.title: Draft service performance report
_source.content: Investigate slow searches and service response time. The unpublished report includes production traces and detailed incident analysis.

_source.title: Grant the least required privileges
_source.content: Separate cluster privileges from index privileges. Give an analyst read access to the permitted data without granting write permissions.

_source.title: Rotate application API keys
_source.content: Replace old application credentials with new API keys. Revoke unused keys and use a restricted role descriptor.

_source.title: Restrict document visibility
_source.content: Tenant restrictions must apply consistently to lexical and vector retrieval. A result from another tenant is unacceptable even when highly relevant.

_source.title: Encrypt traffic between nodes
_source.content: Transport encryption protects cluster communications. Keep certificate names, trust configuration and renewal procedures consistent.

_source.title: Restore a retained snapshot
_source.content: Register the shared repository and inspect the snapshot before restoring an index. Verify the recovered document count and health.

_source.title: Rollover a log data stream
_source.content: A data stream routes append-only events to a write index. Rollover opens a new backing index when age or size conditions are met.

_source.title: Retain recent data in hot storage
_source.content: Use a lifecycle policy to move old indices to less expensive tiers. Keep frequently searched data on a tier appropriate for its workload.

_source.title: Avoid oversized shards
_source.content: Shard sizes affect recovery time and storage management. Choose a rollover threshold based on measurements from the actual workload.

_source.title: Semantic search field naming
_source.content: The words semantic search also appear in this glossary. It lists field names and configuration labels but does not explain how meaning-based retrieval works.

_source.title: Paraphrases and useful passages
_source.content: Questions with different wording can ask for the same information. Compare sentence embeddings to locate a passage that answers the underlying question.
